e.title: Bayesian IBNR for Cyber (CAS)
e.summary: CAS 贝叶斯网络风险 IBNR 模型（nimble）：负二项似然+时间/延迟预测因子估计未决网络理赔
e.body: bayesIBNRcyber 是 CAS 研究仓库：用 R 的 nimble 包实现贝叶斯网络风险 IBNR（已发生未报告理赔）模型——负二项似然配合时间与延迟特定的预测因子，基于历史数据预测网络事件计数。网络风险是新险种，IBNR 估计是网络险准备金的前沿问题。对 RIAA：贝叶斯×新风险（网络险）准备金建模的官方研究参考。与 [[cyber-risk-classification]]（网络风险分类）、[[reserving-robust]]（稳健准备金）、[[chainladder]]（经典链梯）互补。关联 [[insurance-governance]]、[[reinsurance]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：CAS 官方研究，nimble 贝叶斯网络 IBNR（负二项+时间/延迟预测因子）
e.summary_en: CAS Bayesian IBNR model for cyber incidents (nimble): negative-binomial likelihood with time/delay predictors to estimate unreported cyber claims
e.summary_hk: CAS 貝葉斯網絡風險 IBNR 模型（nimble）：負二項似然+時間/延遲預測因子估計未決網絡理賠
e.body_en: bayesIBNRcyber is a CAS research repo: a Bayesian model for estimating incurred-but-not-reported (IBNR) cyber incidents using R's nimble package — a negative-binomial likelihood with time- and delay-specific predictors forecasting incident counts from historical data. Cyber is a new risk class and cyber IBNR is a frontier reserving problem. For RIAA: the official research reference for Bayesian × emerging-risk (cyber) reserving. Complements [[cyber-risk-classification]] (cyber-risk taxonomy), [[reserving-robust]] (robust reserving) and [[chainladder]] (classic chain ladder). Related: [[insurance-governance]], [[reinsurance]].
e.body_hk: bayesIBNRcyber 是 CAS 研究倉庫：用 R 的 nimble 包實現貝葉斯網絡風險 IBNR（已發生未報告理賠）模型——負二項似然配合時間與延遲特定的預測因子，基於歷史數據預測網絡事件計數。網絡風險是新險種，IBNR 估計是網絡險準備金的前沿問題。對 RIAA：貝葉斯×新風險（網絡險）準備金建模的官方研究參考。與 [[cyber-risk-classification]]（網絡風險分類）、[[reserving-robust]]（穩健準備金）、[[chainladder]]（經典鏈梯）互補。關聯 [[insurance-governance]]、[[reinsurance]]。
